extracted.intended_audience: researchers, innovators, educators, artists and applicants seeking Wellcome grant funding
extracted.subtask_description: Overview of Wellcome's funding schemes and practical guidance for prospective applicants and current grantholders, including what areas and types of activity are supported, where to apply, and where to find more detailed scheme-specific deadlines and advice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Alignment with Wellcome's new strategy
rubrics_metrics.description: The way we fund research is changing to support our new strategy. A simplified set of funding schemes will be open for applications in summer 2021.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should ensure projects align with Wellcome's updated strategic priorities; expect scheme changes and a simplified set of opportunities launching in summer 2021.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check relevant scheme pages and deadlines
rubrics_metrics.description: Our current funding schemes will close during 2021. Most will be open for one or two more application rounds, depending on the scheme. Check the relevant scheme pages for application deadlines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not rely on this overview for deadlines—consult the specific scheme page for exact closing dates and whether that scheme remains open.

rubrics_metrics.name: Supported funding areas
rubrics_metrics.description: Our schemes support individuals, teams, resources, seed ideas, places and major initiatives in these areas: biomedical science; population health; product development and applied research; humanities and social science; public engagement and creative industries.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When choosing where to apply, match your proposal to one of these stated thematic areas; scheme eligibility and fit depends on area alignment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Supported types of support
rubrics_metrics.description: We support individuals, teams, resources, seed ideas, places and major initiatives.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identify which type of support your work requires (e.g., individual fellowship vs team grant vs resource funding) and select the scheme tailored to that type.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use Grant Tracker to apply and manage grants
rubrics_metrics.description: Apply for a grant or manage an existing one through our online system. Log in to Grant Tracker.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All applications and ongoing grant management are handled through Grant Tracker—ensure you have access and use it for submissions and post-award administration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Compare biomedical schemes via partner resources
rubrics_metrics.description: View and compare biomedical research funding schemes offered by Wellcome and seven other UK funders on the Medical Research Council website (opens in a new tab).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use external comparison tools (e.g., MRC site) to identify overlapping/similar funding opportunities and to find the best match among UK funders.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consult tailored funding guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: View funding guidance if you need help or advice with: looking for funding; a funding application; an existing Wellcome grant.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Access the specific guidance pages for practical advice on searching for schemes, preparing applications, and managing active grants; follow the step-by-step support relevant to your situation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Coronavirus (Covid-19) guidance for applicants and grantholders
rubrics_metrics.description: Coronavirus (Covid-19): What you need to know if you're a grant applicant or grantholder.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Review COVID-19–specific policies and instructions that may affect applications, project delivery, reporting, or grant management during the pandemic.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support for research career development
rubrics_metrics.description: See what we offer at key career stages and how we support research careers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If your objective is career development, identify schemes and resources targeted at your career stage (early, mid, senior) and follow their specific eligibility and application advice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transparency about funded people and projects
rubrics_metrics.description: Find out about the people and projects we've funded, including grants awarded, researcher stories and grant funding data.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use published grant portfolios, researcher stories and funding data to understand the kinds of projects Wellcome funds and to benchmark your proposal's fit and scale.

rubrics_metrics.name: Stay informed via the research newsletter
rubrics_metrics.description: Sign up to our research newsletter: Stay up to date with funding news, policy changes and events with our bimonthly email.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Subscribe to receive timely announcements about scheme openings, policy updates, deadlines and events relevant to applicants and grantholders.
